description_en: Creates a trace query task based on a topic and a message ID, and returns the task ID. You can then call the OnsTraceGetResult operation with the returned task ID to retrieve the detailed message trace
description_zh: 通过传入Topic名称和Message ID创建轨迹查询任务，得到该查询任务的ID。您需要再调用OnsTraceGetResult接口，传入返回的查询任务ID，获取消息轨迹的详细结果
name: OnsTraceQueryByMsgId

parameters.help_en: The topic of the message to query
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en: The ID of the message to query. This is the message ID
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消息的ID，即Message ID
parameters.name: msg_id

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the query time range. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的时间范围的起始时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the query time range. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的时间范围的结束时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the topic of the message belongs
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消息的Topic所对应的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

QueryId.description_en: The ID of the query task. Call the [OnsTraceGetResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59832.html） operation with this task ID to get the detailed results
QueryId.description_zh: 该查询任务的ID，您需要根据该任务ID再调用[OnsTraceGetResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59832.html）接口获取详细结果

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID. Use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
